correctness.rationale: The n=3 distance-class bound sums min(C(3,k)2^k,C(3,k)2^(3-k))=1+6+6+1=14. At equality cardinalities force (2,7) up to user swap. Two words at Hamming distance r generate 2^(3-r) disjoint cross-row collision pairs in the entire cube; deleting one word can remove all collisions only at r=3. With antipodal words, deleting either of their two elements removes the unique collision. Four antipodal unordered pairs times two omitted words times two user orientations gives exactly 16 ordered extrema and one common-cube-isometry/user-swap orbit. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all 255^2 ordered nonempty binary-code pairs returned max 14 and 16 extremizers. The finite experiment is exhaustive for n=3 only.
